summaries.text: This resolution commemorates the passage of four years since the tragic building collapse in Surfside, Florida, on June 24, 2021, and honors the survivors and lives lost in the collapse.

title: A resolution commemorating the passage of 4 years since the tragic building collapse in Surfside, Florida, on June 24, 2021.
